name: Akai Onna no Ko
source:
The observation meeting that took place in the country should have been a happy trip that would have left behind memories from the summer holidays.

But...

――the training camp of the astronomy club comes at a end without a single star having been seen.



(Translated from the [URL=http://n-linear.org/redgirl/index.html]official page[/URL])
